title: Billable report figures are the same to the cent after the release
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the production test account.
  • Before the release, export Sales, Sales By Customer, Sales By Representative, Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency, Shop Efficiency, Parts Velocity, Sales Tax Collected, A/R Aging, Requested Parts, Payroll Timesheet and the dashboard cards for the last 12 months, and keep the files.
  • Make sure no internal or no-charge work order and no no-charge line exists in the organization after the release.
custom_steps: 1. Export the same reports for the same 12 months.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Every row and every total equals the file kept before the release, to the cent.
  • The $0 invoices made before the release are still in them as billable invoices.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-R14: “Rule zero. For billable work orders and billable lines no report, dashboard card or export changes any number: every figure a report gives today for billable work is the same after the release, to the cent. The only differences are the ones this story names: a whole internal or no-charge work order leaves the money reports, a no-charge line adds no revenue, cost, invoiced hours or units. The exclusion is implemented once, as a shared predicate for "no-charge work order" and one for "no-charge line" that every report calls, the way void invoices are excluded today, not as a hand-written condition per query. A verify ticket runs every report and card on the staging database before and after, same date range, with no internal or no-charge data present, and compares: zero difference; only then is a work order with one no-charge line added and each report checked for what moved. Verify ticket: SV-12297.”
  • S9-R15: “Reports not named above, checked and unchanged under rule zero: Requested Parts, Payroll Timesheet and the Journal Entries report (which shows the Close and no-charge-line entries with the category account on the debit side like any entry). Customers Spending excludes whole internal and no-charge work orders with the shared predicate of S9-R14; a billable work order with a no-charge line stays in with its invoice total, the line adds $0. Sales Follow Up and Vendors Expenses were removed from ShopView in v26.45.0 (SV-12106); if either returns, it takes the shared predicate then.”
  • S9-E2: “The $0 invoices created before this feature stay billable invoices in every report, as today; they are not re-classified.”
  • Feature Overview, Out of Scope: “Automatically re-marking past $0 invoices. An optional one-time tool may follow; the books are never touched.”

From: Jira tickets under epic SV-11665 (saved 12 Nov 2026, sources/JIRA-SV-11665-tickets-2026-11-12.md), read 12 Nov 2026

  • Jira SV-12297: “After the deployment, with no internal or no-charge work order and no no-charge line in the sample, export the same reports for the same range: every row and every total is identical.”
